m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited crew + everyone global doctrine, the g4-implement handoff in FULL, and the load-bearing source (grip_baseline.py fit_grip_baseline_from_laps + weekend_neighbors, grip_store.py get_grip_at, tyre_supplant.py). Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew+everyone doctrine + handoff + 3 source files read; handoff complete

m1-probe.title: Probe 2023 DB, select circuit/session-pair scope, check stop condition
m1-probe.imperative: Run a read-only sqlite probe against C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/f1_data_2023.db to measure, per circuit and session, clean-lap counts, usable driver-stints, compound coverage, rain flag, and same-driver/same-compound cross-session overlap for candidate session pairs (FP-vs-FP). Select 3-5 contrasting circuits (street / high-speed / technical) with enough same-driver/same-compound cross-session laps to run a meaningful reconciliation. If the DB lacks enough such laps ANYWHERE, hit the stop condition and report rather than fabricate. Attest c1 with the chosen scope + justification.

postconditions.statement: scope (circuits + session pairs) selected with data-adequacy evidence, or stop condition documented
postconditions.satisfied_by: Scope: Monaco FP2/FP3 (street/low-speed, 17 cells), Spain FP1/FP2 (aero, 26), Netherlands FP1/FP2 (banked-technical, 13), Saudi Arabia FP1/FP2 (high-speed street, 14). All dry. 10 teams x2 drivers -> clean team-stratified 50/50 split. Stop condition NOT hit.

constraints: state exact scope, no full-season claim

m2-harness.title: Build held-out reconciliation harness end to end
m2-harness.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_grip_heldout.py: per chosen session pair, split drivers 50/50 stratified-by-team fixed-seed (disjoint asserted), fit G on fit-set laps only via fit_grip_baseline_from_laps (lap-frame seam), upsert to a temp GripStore, then for held-out drivers compute RAW-pace cross-session reconciliation error BEFORE vs AFTER subtracting each session's G via get_grip_at, bucketed by compound + coarse tyre-age/fuel proxy (NO regression on the truth side -> leakage-avoidance by design). Assert harness ran, split disjoint, a numeric per-circuit result exists, and the leakage/rank check passed; do NOT assert after<before. PRINT before/after per-circuit + aggregate and write .agent-work/663-grip-g/g4-heldout-results.json. Test-after evidence. Attest c1 (harness reasoned/reviewed), then advance c2 (pytest exit 0).

postconditions.statement: harness authored; honest-null operationalization + leakage-by-design verified by inspection
postconditions.satisfied_by: Honest-null operationalization verified by inspection: pytest asserts harness-ran + disjoint-split + numeric-result + regression-free-truth-side + neg-control-computed; NO assert after<before. Leakage-by-design: truth side = raw fastest-3 push pace, no OLS. Scientific verdict (NULL) printed+JSON, never asserted.

postconditions.statement: pytest harness runs to completion exit 0 (regardless of scientific outcome), prints real before/after numbers

constraints: pytest exit 0 regardless of scientific result

m3-simplify.title: simplification_limits clean on the new file
m3-simplify.imperative: Run the project simplification_limits self-check over the new test file and address anything it flags. Advance c1 (command exit 0).

why_trail.why: Handoff complete (task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present). G = per-session curve over cumulative_track_laps; reconciliation reduces to whether fit-set-derived (G_A-G_B) predicts held-out driver raw (pace_A-pace_B). Leakage-avoidance by design: raw bucketed pace on truth side, no OLS. Honest-null: assert harness-ran+disjoint+numeric+leakage-check, never after<before.

4 contrasting dry circuits selected; each has >=13 same-driver/same-compound cross-session cells (>=~6 survive the 50/50 split), fit-set retains >=~4 usable stints/session for a real 'ok' G fit. Team stratification fully populated.

Measured NEGATIVE: subtracting G worsens held-out cross-session reconciliation (before RMS 3.02s -> after 7.72s, +155%, 0/4 circuits improved). Cause: per-session saturating-curve fits structurally unidentified on FP data (offset<->asy corr ~=-1.0, offsets 102-111s) -- confirmed G-intrinsic (full-field fit equally degenerate), not a split artifact. Curve-only variant even worse (26s); swap neg-control confirms directional signal. Honest-null: complete valid deliverable.
